indications.description: Unresectable/metastatic KIT-positive GIST or adjuvant treatment after resection when relapse risk is significant.

treatment.schedule_summary: Imatinib 400 mg orally once daily with food. Advanced GIST continues until progression/unacceptable toxicity; specialist escalation to 800 mg/day uses 400 mg twice daily. NCCP adjuvant treatment is up to 3 years after resection.

action.message: Source disagreement: NCCP lists 300 mg after a first severe count event and 200 mg after a second, after grade ≤1 recovery. Glivec GIST starting-400-mg guidance resumes the previous dose after ANC ≥1.5 AND platelets ≥75, then 300 mg for recurrence. Consultant/pharmacy must reconcile source, occurrence, current dose and recovery; no automatic prescription.

eligibility: Adult KIT/CD117-positive unresectable/metastatic GIST, or resected GIST at significant relapse risk.
ECOG 0–3; adequate marrow, renal and liver function.
exclusions: Low recurrence risk for adjuvant treatment.
monitoring: Baseline full blood count, renal/liver profile, ECG and hepatitis B screen (HBsAg and core antibody).
FBC every 2 weeks for the first 12 weeks, then monthly or as indicated; renal/liver profiles monthly.

Monitor weight/fluid retention, cardiac/renal symptoms and bleeding. Check TSH in thyroidectomy patients taking thyroxine. HBV-positive patients need specialist management and monitoring through treatment and several months afterwards.
